item.title: Hungary’s Orban says EU bigger threat than Russia before April elections
item.description: 'Illiberal' PM, endorsed by ally Trump this week, to receive US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Sunday.

item.description: UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese faces calls to step down by France and Germany despite debunked remarks.

item.title: Onsite gunmen force MSF to stop work at Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
item.description: Medical charity's announcement comes on the heels of Israel's recent ban on its operations in Gaza.

item.title: Real Madrid thrash Real Sociedad 4-1 to move top of La Liga
item.description: Vinicius Jr strikes twice ⁠from penalty spot as Madrid move provisionally above Barcelona, who play Girona on Monday.

item.title: US army launches retaliatory strikes on dozens of ISIL targets in Syria
item.description: Operation Hawkeye has killed and captured more than 50 ISIL fighters after hitting about 100 targets.

item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,452 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: Gunmen kill at least 32 people in northern Nigeria, residents say
item.description: Witnesses say the motorcycle riding gunmen attacked three communities in northern Nigeria, killing and abducting dozens.

item.title: Israeli forces kill nine Palestinians in Gaza, attack southern Lebanon
item.description: Medical sources say Israeli forces killed five Palestinians in southern Khan Younis and four in northern al-Faluja.

item.title: Cyclone Gezani kills four in Mozambique as Madagascar assesses damage
item.description: Powerful storm batters Mozambique's Inhambane a day after killing at least 41 people in Madagascar.

item.title: LIVE: Israel kills at least nine Palestinians in Gaza since dawn
item.description: The killings add to the death toll of 591 since October 10 'ceasefire' that Israel has violated more than 1,600 times.
